name: ChariKiss
source:
WELCOME TO ST. BERNADETTE'S!

Meet Charity, a college freshman who just moved to the middle of nowhere to attend St. Bernadette's University. With her beloved houseplant Hubert as her only confidant and a determination to "kiss women and fu-" well, you'll see! She's ready for independence. What she didn't realize? St. Bernadette's is an all-girls university. Talk about happy accidents!

Charity's first days at college are a rollercoaster of new crushes, inner monologues, and foot-in-mouth moments. Between getting lost on the one-line subway (how??) and trying not to stare at her teacher's assets, she'll meet a cast of charming girls – each with their own quirks and romance potential.

Follow along as Charity navigates her way through awkward sleepovers, surprise shower encounters, and the one eternal lesbian question: "Was that flirting or just being nice?" Her thoughts are unfiltered, her social skills are questionable, and her heart is ready for adventure.

[From [url=https://veebuggsy.itch.io/charikiss]itch.io[/url]]
